power.automation.rules.title: Global settings
power.automation.rules.description: These apply to every printer. After a print, a printer turns off by itself only when the print finished. It stays on after a cancelled or a failed print, and for as long as a print is paused. A printer left on and idle can be turned off after a time you set here.
power.automation.delay.label: Global wait before turning off after a print
power.automation.delay.hint: For every printer that turns off after a print and has no wait of its own below. The plug stays on this long after the print ends and the printer stops moving, so the nozzle can cool.
power.automation.confirm.label: Ask before turning off by hand
power.automation.confirm.hint: Turning off cuts the printer's mains power. With this off, one press on Turn off does it.
power.automation.idle.label: Turn off a printer that is on and idle
power.automation.idle.hint: For every printer with no value of its own below. A printer that is on and has not printed or moved for this long is turned off. Leave it empty to never do this. The shortest time is 10 minutes.
power.automation.idle.invalid: Write the hours as a number, such as 2 or 1.5.
power.automation.printers.title: Defaults for each printer
power.automation.printers.description: What each printer does unless you say otherwise. A printer switched on here turns off after every print. On the printer's own page you can still switch this on or off for a single print. Each printer waits the global time ({delay}), unless you give it a wait of its own here.
power.automation.printers.idleOf: Hours until {printer} is turned off when idle
power.switch.askNote: This cuts the printer's mains power. Make sure the printer is idle and the nozzle has cooled down.

power.automation.energy.title: Energy and cost
power.automation.energy.description: These settings apply to every energy and cost figure of Power Control. The first price you save also counts for the energy recorded before it. A later price counts from the moment you save it, unless you choose to use it for past energy too.
power.automation.energy.result.month: At this price, this month costs {cost} so far.
power.automation.energy.result.mixed: This month costs {cost} so far. Energy from before the change keeps its earlier price.
power.automation.energy.result.none: No energy is recorded for this month yet. Cost shows as soon as a plug reports.
power.automation.energy.keep.label: Keep records for
power.automation.energy.keep.hint: Older energy records are deleted. Choose 7 to 3650 days.
power.automation.energy.keep.shorter: Records older than {days} days are deleted when you save. This cannot be undone.
power.automation.energy.keep.paused: The saved energy settings could not be read, so no record is deleted for its age yet. Check the number of days. Records older than {days} days are deleted when you save. This cannot be undone.
power.automation.energy.zone.label: Time zone
power.automation.energy.zone.hint: Days and night hours follow this zone. Type a city to find it in the list. With no zone chosen they follow the server clock.
power.automation.energy.currency.label: Currency
power.automation.energy.currency.hint: A short label shown with every cost, such as EUR. Changing it does not convert figures.
power.automation.energy.price.label: Price per kWh
power.automation.energy.price.hint: Leave it empty to remove the price and every earlier price.
power.automation.energy.price.clearing: Every saved price is deleted when you save, and costs disappear for all past energy. A price you enter later counts for all past energy too. This cannot be undone.
power.automation.energy.price.invalid: Write the price as a number, such as 0.32.
power.automation.energy.night.label: Day and night price
power.automation.energy.night.hint: Use a second price during the night hours.
power.automation.energy.nightPrice.label: Night price per kWh
power.automation.energy.nightPrice.hint: It counts between the two hours below.
power.automation.energy.nightStart.label: Night starts
power.automation.energy.nightStart.hint: The hour from which the night price counts.
power.automation.energy.nightEnd.label: Night ends
power.automation.energy.nightEnd.hint: The hour from which the day price counts again.
power.automation.energy.night.invalid: The night must start and end at different hours.
power.automation.energy.past.label: Use for past energy too
power.automation.energy.past.hint: Off: the new price counts from now on, and earlier energy keeps its price. On: the new price replaces every earlier price.
